observed: Both runs completed explicit 120-second VOLT1 USB+BLE windows. Separate session identities are retained; no counters are subtracted across boots/sessions.

USB trusted complete frames screen04=7897 with 15 missing sequence observations; screen05=7381 with 0 internal sequence gaps. Capture FPS from device timestamps changed 65.900556 to 61.464674 (-6.731%). USB receive FPS changed 65.811374 to 61.508761; BLE 3816/31.815184 FPS to 3944/32.867940 FPS. BLE still has 3433 missing sequence observations in screen05, so zero ADC CRC is not zero transport loss.
Complete-frame duration mean rose 10761.470us to 11922.435us (+1160.965us). Device start interval rose 15174.379us to 16269.508us (+1095.129us).

Non-overlapping summary subsets (7095 and 6630 frames) show sampleReadUs/frame 2161.368us to 3368.814us (+1207.447us); FreshChecked calls/frame fell 12.7825 to 10.4980 (-17.872%). Elapsed read time per invocation approximately 169.088us to 320.899us; the earlier invocation can contain internal CRC retries, so this is not a clean per-wire-transaction benchmark.

CRC health counters screen04 reject 5168/106486 checked reads (4.8532%); screen05 reject 0/79417. Health spans are 119.390852s and 118.658930s and include auxiliary reads, not exact 120s science-only endpoints. Frame-reported io_retry sums are 4802 and 0.

X02 points fell 371 to 0. X12 remains only S1D2: 4640/7897 observed S1D2 points (58.756%) to 480/7381 (6.503%). X12 is UNSTABLE, not CRC; the passive floating fixture is not a known stable voltage source.

Health interval is actually 64. Engine128/256 are successful warmup observations, 384/512 successful capture observations. Screen05 observed successful cumulative checks through engine7680, entry=0; engine6080 diagnostic is absent and not claimed successful. Both final authoritative configurations are CAP8 and quarantine/restore failure queries are zero.

Before/after PERF windows are about120.366s, not exact capture boundaries: screen05 pub/fresh+7402, stale+0, dropOut+1, usbDrop+0, queueDrop+121. USBQ dDrop/cDrop/expired/cExpired/partial increments are all0; dSubmit+7407. These layer counters and observation windows must not be equated with PC frame receipt.
conclusions.supported_inference: The new read path has a measured increase in elapsed sample-read work despite fewer FreshChecked calls and no CRC retries. Its +1.207ms/frame component increase is close to the complete-frame +1.161ms and start-interval +1.095ms changes, making added selected-read-path elapsed time a strong explanation for the lower capture FPS in this comparison.
not_proven: This is not a same-build/same-clock randomized A/B: boot selected SDK-reported actual1111000Hz for screen04 and2000000Hz for screen05; floating-input behavior and adaptive sampling/profile hit rates also changed. The screen04 code baseline is bc99767-dirty, not4bf31db.

sampleReadUs includes task scheduling, SPI-owner mutex/queue/completion, GPIO handoff and readback; no timing breakdown separates CPU instruction cost, SDK blocking, preemption or individual GPIO calls. Do not attribute all added elapsed time specifically to bit-sampling instructions.
Nominal or SDK-reported SPI clock alone does not predict capture FPS. The aggregate timing components may overlap and are not a complete additive CPU budget.
Reduced X12 or similar S1D1 voltage values do not prove precision accuracy or an unchanged physical stimulus. No precision PASS is assigned.
Zero rejected CRC in this finite VOLT1 interval does not prove zero runtime CRC across all modes, rows, loads or future uptime.
No MFAULT/reset/WDT text was observed by the available formal/debug observers; this is an observation, not a universal no-fault proof.
The existing budget and safety checks are unchanged; this review makes no recommendation to disable or bypass them.
